scope: Tiny paired local contracts;root-owned runtime qualification is separate.

cases.title: Check the query meaning before its execution plan
cases.input_contract: Execute the projection query and return ordered(id, doubled) tuples. Compare all nine rows with the literal rule id 3..11, doubled=20*id.
cases.expected: Nine tuples from(3,60) through(11,220), with no missing or extra identities.
cases.verification: Assert the complete tuple list, not only the first/last rows or a printed plan.

cases.title: Capture each extended planning stage
cases.input_contract: Return EXPLAIN EXTENDED text for the supplied query. Permit only EXTENDED or FORMATTED as the mode and reject another mode.
cases.expected: Text includes Parsed Logical Plan, Analyzed Logical Plan, Optimized Logical Plan and Physical Plan sections. An invalid mode is rejected.
cases.verification: Assert all four section labels and an explicit invalid-mode exception.

cases.title: Inspect the scan scope for column pruning
cases.input_contract: Capture FORMATTED output and extract lines containing ReadSchema. Verify that the projection scan requests id and amount but not group_id or unused_payload. Also locate Filter and Project operators.
cases.expected: ReadSchema includes id:bigint and amount:bigint only among the four stored fields. Filter and Project evidence are present.
cases.verification: Assert needed/excluded fields in the extracted scan lines rather than in the entire extended plan.

cases.title: Connect grouped output to a redistribution boundary
cases.input_contract: Execute the grouped aggregate and capture its FORMATTED plan. Return group_id, n, total and locate aggregate plus Exchange operators under the fixed AQE-disabled configuration.
cases.expected: Groups 0,1,2 each have n3 with totals 180,210,240. The plan shows aggregation and an Exchange.
cases.verification: Assert all group tuples independently, then assert the relevant operator markers and recorded AQE setting.

cases.title: Normalize incidental identifiers without erasing semantics
cases.input_contract: Replace expression-number suffixes such as#123 with#ID and the exact owned root path with<owned-root> in plan text. Preserve operators, field names, predicates and partitioning descriptions.
cases.expected: A synthetic Project id#123L becomes Project id#IDL;the current temporary root is absent from normalized actual plan text.
cases.verification: Assert the synthetic replacement and required semantic tokens after normalizing the actual plan.

cases.title: Compare equivalent query forms with separate semantic and plan evidence
cases.input_contract: Execute a nested projection/filter form of the direct query and compare its exact rows. Capture its extended plan and return a bounded receipt containing Spark version, ANSI, AQE and shuffle partition settings.
cases.expected: The nested query has the same nine tuples. Receipt shows Spark 4.0.1, ANSItrue, AQEfalse, shuffle partitions 2. Both extended plans expose an optimized stage.
cases.verification: Assert full output parity with the literal oracle and exact controlled settings;do not assert whole-plan byte equality or faster execution.
